title: Gogetsuji Legends
note: Fighting game on the Cave board (CAVE): health, health_p2, time, credits, power, power_p2 (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Cave 68000 work RAM from 0x400000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0xE0 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0xE0 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x40 (FBNeo cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0x40 (FBNeo cheat database)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
